title: POT generation does not include exported String / Array[String]
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 
- v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee] (Forward+ Renderer)
- v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8] (Mobile Renderer)


### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Debian GNU/Linux 12 (bookworm) 12 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 5700 (RADV NAVI10) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

Generating a POT file from `Project` > `Project Settings` > `Localization` > `POT Generation` does not include `@export`ed `Array[String]`.
I assume this relates to #90053

I would expect / love to have exported Arrays (in my case used messages of story NPCs in a prototype game for university) to be included in the POT Generation. 

In the original project this is in the "main-world" scene, where some NPCs (`Character3D`) export an `Array[String]` as messages, with which the user can interact.


### Steps to reproduce

1. Create `Label` node and attach a new script. (Add String "Hello from label.text" to `Label.text`)
2. Add following code to script, do something with String and Array in `_ready()`:
```gdscript
@export var messages: Array[String] = ["Array0","Array1"]
@export var message: String = "String"
```
4. Fill exported String and Array with some strings.
5. Go to `Project` > `Project Settings` > `Localization` > `POT Generation`. Add main scene and script and click `Generate POT`

The generated template does neither contain exported String nor Array:
```pot
# LANGUAGE translation for New Game Project for the following files:
# res://label.gd
# res://label.tscn
#
# FIRST AUTHOR <EMAIL@ADDRESS>, YEAR.
#
#, fuzzy
msgid ""
msgstr ""
"Project-Id-Version: New Game Project\n"
"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8\n"
"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8-bit\n"

#: label.tscn
msgid "Hello from label.text"
msgstr ""
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[localization-MRP.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19209760/localization-MRP.zip)
